purpose: Describe module responsibilities and dependency boundaries for safer refactors.

modules.responsibility: Render operator UI and interact with API contracts.
Expose HTTP endpoints and orchestrate bot/analytics services.
Execute observer and publisher automation with fail-closed guards.

Single source of truth for observer, publisher, scheduler, and NL-webhook runtime state. Owns in-memory controls, atomic persistence to ARTIFACTS_DIR/runtime-controls.json, and optimistic concurrency via stateVersion.
modules.design_intent: Consolidated from the former lib/controls.ts (in-memory) and lib/runtimeControls.ts (persistence) on 2026-08-08. Both shims were deleted. Importing state through any aggregation layer is forbidden because a duplicate error class in the old shim broke instanceof checks and downgraded HTTP 409 conflict responses to 500.
modules.change_impact: server.ts, bot.ts, routes/api/control.ts, routes/api/nl.ts, routes/api/ai.ts, lib/observer/*, lib/publisher/*

modules.responsibility: Gap-driven publishing orchestration: tick loop, interval computation, presets, quiet/active hour multipliers, and jitter.
modules.design_intent: lib/scheduler/ holds types and presets; lib/scheduler.ts holds the orchestration loop. The barrel re-exports startScheduler from the parent file, so callers import lib/scheduler/index.js and never reach past it.

modules.responsibility: Transform activity logs into analytics payloads and guidance.
Define and validate runtime and data contracts.

barrel_exports.policy: Every multi-file lib module exposes exactly one public entry point. Cross-module imports go through it; reaching into a sibling module's internal files is a boundary violation.

removed_modules.reason: Deprecated re-export shims over lib/state/. Kept a duplicate RuntimeControlsVersionConflictError class that no code path threw, so instanceof never matched and POST /api/control-panel returned 500 instead of 409 on a version conflict.

refactor_policy: Prefer extracting by feature slice: route + state + API clients + presentational components.
Preserve fail-closed automation and contract validation during UI refactors.
When consolidating a module, delete the old entry point in the same change. Compatibility shims that duplicate types or error classes silently break instanceof and type narrowing.
